answer: New identities start on a bare knoll with zero history, so farming fake accounts costs real stake plus repeated proof-of-work upkeep with no yield until trust accrues. Each agent must stake collateral and tend a verifiable orchard plot, logging harvests to a public terrace ledger over many epochs. Attackers must outspend honest growers across the whole terrace, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0215 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
